_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with two-sided extremes canceling; base rate favors score staying inside the band unless a named breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency coil; narrative silent on forward phase/direction (flows only)
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds ~45-60, 30d momentum stays muted, funding near flat across next 12h windows
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks >62 with momentum expansion (up) or CVD/funding flush drives F&G <39 (down into Anxiety)
